newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-RTZ-CRA unit buys Esso stake in coal mine.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-RTZ-CRA unit buys Esso stake in coal mine.

text.p: RTZ-CRA unit Pacific Coal Pty Ltd said on Monday it had signed an agreement to buy Esso Australia Resources Ltd's 25 percent stake in the Hail Creek coal mine joint venture for an undisclosed sum.
"It's agreed between the parties that the purchase price will remain confidential," a Pacific Coal spokesman said.
Pacific Coal said in a statement the sale was expected to be completed in early 1997 once government approvals were obtained.
Esso Australia is a unit of U.S.-based Exxon Corp.
Pacific Coal also said it planned to on-sell 1.33 percent to Japan's Marubeni Coal Pty Ltd and 0.67 percent to Sumitomo Corp unit Sumisho Coal Development Pty Ltd, both partners in Hail Creek.
The resulting stakes in Hail Creek will be Pacific Coal with 92 percent, Marubeni with 5.33 percent and Sumisho 2.67 percent.

The joint venture partners were completing a final feasibility study to establish a five million tonne-per-year hard coking coal mine at a site near Nebo, 100 km west of Mackay in central Queensland, Pacific Coal said.
It said the mine could be operating by the year 2000.
